notes.title: DEATH IS (not) FINAL
notes.content:
Is it normal to release a remake of a 1-year-old game? No?

About 8 months ago I began porting the game to consoles and somehow corrupted the source code of the game. I had 2 backups. Both failed me.

It was a dark time, indeed. Not only did I have commitments to other platforms to deliver ports, but the latest Steam update of the game was rather buggy. I had no way to make quick fixes to fix the current version. So, if you played the game between April 2024 and now, I apologize. The game has been in a rather shit state.

But I decided not to give up. I crunched 7 days a week for the past 8 months and rebuilt the game from scratch. Yes, really.

This is what's new and improved:
-upgraded to Unity 6 and Universal Render Pipeline
-new shaders and lighting system for an even more Comic Book-like visual style
-new animation system for more-realistic player movement
-new menus and options
-new "One Button Combat" mode for accessibility
-new combat mechanics (ghosts damage you based on proximity, so maintaining distance is now paramount to survival)
-all new, optimized 3D models for EVERY character and enemy
-new camera angles
-new items
-new Sound FX
-new cutscenes
-new logos for non-English versions
-and of course, new scares...

Like a phoenix from the ashes or a specter in the morning light, GHOST at DAWN is back and better than ever.

DEATH IS (not) FINAL

notes.title: Please report bugs here
notes.content: Hi all. I've been fixing the game nonstop and barely getting any sleep for the past few days since the major update. Unity, the game engine used to make this game, had a huge bug right before I launched the latest update for the game, and it set the game back a bit further than I realized. I'm playtesting and taking note of everything I find. I just want to let everyone know that I'm 100% committed to fixing every issue ASAP. If you come across anything wonky, please report it here or message me on twitter or discord. With your help, I can make the game as good as SHOULD be. Thanks and apologies for the bugs!

notes.title: GHOST at DAWN: REBUILD UPDATE INCOMING
notes.content:
I will be uploading the REBUILD update to Steam later today or tomorrow. It will erase your previous save data upon the initial boot up. Unfortunately, this was necessary because of the massive changes made to the game. If you want to finish your current run, do so before installing the new update. 

I assure you another investigation through The Pines Hotel will be worth it. There are new items, sound effects, animations, scares, enemy placements, game mechanics, options, along with a whole new look for the game. This will be the ultimate version of the game. I hope you enjoy it.
